#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

long long mod = 998244353;
int maxN = (int)4e5 + 10;
vector<long long> fact(maxN), infact(maxN);

struct Triplet {
    long long gcd, x, y;
    Triplet(long long gcd, long long x, long long y) : gcd(gcd), x(x), y(y) {}
};

void PreCompute() {
    fact[0] = fact[1] = infact[0] = infact[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < maxN; i++) {
        fact[i] = (fact[i - 1] * (long long)i) % mod;
        infact[i] = (infact[i - 1] * ModInverse(i, mod)) % mod;
    }
}

long long nCr(int n, int r) {
    long long ans = fact[n] * infact[r] % mod;
    ans = ans * infact[n - r] % mod;
    return ans;
}

long long fast(long long a, long long n) {
    if (n == 0) return 1LL;
    long long ans = fast(a, n / 2);
    ans = (ans * ans) % mod;
    if (n % 2 == 1) {
        ans = (ans * a) % mod;
    }
    return ans;
}

Triplet ExtendedEuclideanAlgo(long long a, long long b) {
    if (a == 0) {
        return Triplet(b, 0, 1);
    }
    Triplet ans = ExtendedEuclideanAlgo(b % a, a);
    long long x = ans.y - (b / a) * ans.x;
    long long y = ans.x;
    return Triplet(ans.gcd, x, y);
}

long long ModInverse(long long a, long long m) {
    Triplet ans = ExtendedEuclideanAlgo(a, m);
    if (ans.gcd != 1) {
        return -1;
    } else {
        long long result = (ans.x % m + m) % m;
        return result;
    }
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    PreCompute();
    int n; long long k;
    cin >> n >> k;
    if (k == 0) {
        cout << fact[n] << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    if (n <= k) {
        cout << 0 << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    long long ans = nCr(n, (int)k);
    int cols = n - (int)k;
    long long sum = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i <= cols; i++) {
        long long tempans = nCr(cols, i);
        tempans = (tempans * fast(cols - i, n)) % mod;
        if ((i & 1) == 1) {
            sum -= tempans;
            if (sum < 0) sum += mod;
        } else {
            sum += tempans;
            if (sum >= mod) sum -= mod;
        }
    }
    cout << (2 * ((ans * sum) % mod)) % mod << "\n";
    return 0;
}
